title: eriophorum gracile subsp. coreanum
intro: Eriophorum gracile subsp. coreanum, commonly known as the Korean cotton-grass or white cotton-grass, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Eriophorum gracile subsp. coreanum include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of these bioactive constituents on human health.
